description: English interview question bank. Loaded into interview_questions by scripts/seed_interview_questions.py; the agent falls back to it when LLM question generation fails. target_position is a track: general, backend, frontend or ai (see position_track in backend/agents/interview/nodes.py).

questions.content: What happens between typing a URL into the browser and seeing the page?
What makes an HTTP API RESTful, and when would you pick PUT over PATCH?
Explain the difference between git merge and git rebase, and when you would avoid rebasing.
What is a database index, and when can adding one make things slower?
How do unit tests and integration tests differ, and what would you test at each level?
What is the difference between a process, a thread and a coroutine?
How does asyncio run many I/O tasks on one thread, and what happens if a coroutine calls a blocking function?
How does dependency injection work in FastAPI, and what would you use it for?
How does JWT-based authentication work, and how would you handle logout or token revocation?
Explain transaction isolation levels and give an example of a bug that a weak level allows.
What is SQL injection, and how do parameterized queries prevent it?
What is CORS, and why does the browser send a preflight request?
What is the difference between a Docker image and a container, and why keep images small?
How would you add a cache in front of a slow database query, and how do you keep it from serving stale data?
What does TypeScript add over JavaScript, and what does it not protect you from at runtime?
When would you use a union type instead of an interface hierarchy in TypeScript?
What triggers a React component to re-render, and how would you avoid unnecessary re-renders?
What is useEffect for, and what goes wrong when its dependency array is incomplete?
How do you decide whether state belongs in a component, a parent, or a global store?
What is cross-site scripting, and how do React and a Content Security Policy help prevent it?
Where would you store an access token in a single-page app, and what are the trade-offs?
How does self-attention work in a Transformer, and why is it scaled by the square root of the key dimension?
Walk me through a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, from documents to the final answer.
How do embeddings and cosine similarity let you search text by meaning?
Why combine dense and sparse retrieval, and what does a reranker add on top?
What is the core idea of LoRA, and when would you fine-tune instead of using RAG?
What is overfitting, how do you detect it, and how do you reduce it?
How would you evaluate an LLM feature before shipping it?
What is prompt injection, and how would you defend an LLM app that reads user documents?
